notes: Procedural model of the Cessna 172S Skyhawk SP. Length, wingspan, height, wing area, wheelbase, propeller diameter and tyre sizes follow the published Pilot’s Operating Handbook figures; section shapes, planform details and the placement of engine and cabin items are Toolbox approximations for orientation. The panel shown is the conventional six-instrument layout; most aircraft built from 2005 have the Garmin G1000 instead. Doors, flaps, ailerons, elevator, trim tab, rudder, nose-wheel steering, cowling, oil door, dipstick, fuel caps and seats move about their real hinges. For learning only; the aircraft’s own handbook governs any real flight.
